train_ppo_policy: train a PPO policy for MetaMaze-misc environment using JAX and Flax with configurable hyperparameters
create_batch_manager: create a BatchManager to manage rollout buffers with GAE lambda discounting and n-step returns
calculate_gae_advantages: calculate generalized advantage estimation (GAE) advantages and targets from values rewards and dones
compute_actor_critic_loss: compute the combined PPO actor and critic loss with clipped value and entropy regularization
evaluate_policy_rollout: evaluate a trained policy by running batch rollouts and computing mean cumulative returns
